title: position
description: A director's position on a board question: the design, or its revision after the critiques.

question.description: The question the board was asked, restated in one sentence.

rationale.description: Why, with the evidence it rests on.

risks.description: What could go wrong if the board takes this position.

alternatives.description: Options considered and set aside, each with the reason.

loosens_policy.description: True when the position loosens a policy, the floor or the checker.
